issue.title: Story Provider｜context budget preflight 與可解釋失敗
issue.description:
Project 1 真實 Story generation 失敗：LM Studio 回 HTTP 400，diagnostic 顯示 input 約 26,123 tokens，超過模型 context 8,192。

目前產品在送 request 前沒有用 provider/model 的實際 context capacity 做 budget preflight，使用者只看到 generic HTTP 400。

需實作：

* provider/model context capacity 可稽核來源。
* StoryInput 在送出前估算 token/context budget。
* 超限時 fail clearly，顯示 estimated input、available context、建議縮減/換模型，不發出必然失敗 request。
* Doctor 可報 model context capability，但 Story generation 自身仍必須 fail closed，不可只依 Doctor。
* 不得自動切 cloud 或付費 provider。

Acceptance：

* 8k context + 26k input 在 request 前即 blocked，無 HTTP call。
* 可容納 input 的模型正常執行。
* context metadata missing/unknown 有明確 warning/blocked contract，不假設無限 context。

PR #88 / reviewed HEAD `e60528a998257a0fd8c94120af939208ffdf18b8`

1. **Corrective retry 沒有重新 preflight。**
   - `LocalTextStoryProvider.generate_story()` 只在進入 `for attempt in range(2)` 前算一次 budget。
   - attempt 2 會額外加入 assistant/user corrective messages，卻直接送 `_request(payload)`。
   - 因此 first request 若接近 context 上限，retry 可能超限仍發 HTTP，違反「每次 request 前 fail closed」。

2. **`reserved_output_tokens=2048` 只存在 preflight/audit，沒有被 HTTP request 契約限制。**
   - payload 目前只有 `model / temperature / response_format / messages`，未帶 output token limit。

   - 現有 oversized regression 用 `"x" * 100000`，只能證明極大輸入會被擋，不能證明接近 8k 邊界不會低估。
   - VID-13 的目的就是避免「估算 pass、provider 實際 token 超限」的 fail-open。
   - Required：改用可稽核且 fail-closed 的估算策略（provider/model tokenizer 若可取得；否則使用有安全上界/明確 safety margin 的 fallback），並加入 UUID/hash、CJK、punctuation-heavy StoryInput near-limit regression。若有原 26k failure snapshot，應驗證 estimator 不低估到會錯誤放行。

issue.title: WebUI / API 效能｜thumbnail source fingerprint 重複雜湊
issue.description:
真實 Project 1（2.45GB source、17 segments）可重現 storyboard/status API timeout。

Root cause evidence：`storyboard_for_api()` 對每個 segment 取 thumbnail path，而 `_thumbnail_path()` 會對大型 source 重算完整 SHA-256；相同 source 被 per-segment 重複 hash，造成 API timeout / UI stale。

需實作：

* source fingerprint 使用既有 persistent media fingerprint / DB metadata / cache reuse，不得每個 segment 重讀整個大型檔案。
* thumbnail key 必須維持 deterministic、source change 可正確 invalidate。
* concurrent requests 不重複做相同 full-file hash。
* API 不應因 thumbnail metadata 計算阻塞 project/status 主資料。

Acceptance：

* 2GB+ source、20+ segments 不會 per-segment full-file rehash。
* storyboard/status API 在合理時間內回應。
* source fingerprint 改變時 thumbnail cache 正確 invalidated。
* Windows 真實大型素材 regression。

   - 120/250ms latency 是有價值的實測，但「API read-path new full-file hashes = 0」目前這個 metric 證據無效。
   - Required：讓 acceptance 真正取得 server process 的 hash count（例如同 process/thread、child 回傳 metrics、或可稽核 instrumentation），並重跑真實 Windows 2.5GB acceptance。

Keep PR #89 Draft、VID-14 In Progress。保留現有 single-flight / persisted reuse / API nonblocking 設計，補強 fingerprint validity，不要退回 per-segment full hashing。

issue.title: Perception publish gate｜multi-frame evidence skipped 不得假性成功
issue.description:
Project 2 正式 perception：4 個 formal multi-frame windows，但 window results = 0、validation=`skipped / insufficient_evidence_frames`、actual vision calls = 0；系統仍發布可用 visual segments。

這不是模型 endpoint 完全不可用：獨立 3-frame local probe 能回合法 JSON，因此問題在正式 perception evidence/publish contract。

需釐清並修正：

* multi-frame window 為何缺 sufficient evidence frames。
* 正式 pipeline 在 mandatory multi-frame evidence skipped/0 results 時，是否允許發布 segments。
* 若允許降級，必須有明確 degraded/needs_review provenance 與 UI，不可看起來與完整 multi-frame success 相同。
* 不支援或未驗證 multi-image 不得默默 single-frame fallback。

Acceptance：

* formal multi-frame success：有 window results + model provenance。
* formal multi-frame unavailable/insufficient：fail closed 或發布為明確 degraded/needs_review，不能冒充完整 success。
* stable UUID / human override 保持。
* 真實 Coffee/Travel fixture 驗證。

issue.description:
<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> 在 PR #92 / <issue id="af2e44ae-e10f-40f1-9e56-b29c074fdb89" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-19/perception-capability-registry-與-mandatory-window-planner-contract">VID-19</issue> 修正後，第一支 Coffee formal Perception 已 PASS；第二支 clip 暴露下一個 authoritative blocker：visual dedupe 後只保留 5 frames，依既有 12s span / large-gap policy 形成 `2 / 1 / 2` non-mandatory fragments，因此 0 mandatory windows、0 model calls，project Perception fail-closed。

## Authoritative baseline

* latest merged main: `118c0246c3093347f004c7cb8966fc5fde672466`
* source: Coffee clip_002, 232,893,552 bytes, SHA-256 `6135cb3e0105aeeccf8fe5ceec2f10323d8302d42d00da27b524a221678b6085`
* prior formal run: `ba27d6bf-12a6-4f47-91bd-f078e3374280`
* pre-dedupe candidates: 14
* visual dedupe removed: 8
* retained timestamps: `0 / 5 / 15 / 55 / 57.984s`
* planner evidence: fragments `2 / 1 / 2`
* mandatory windows / calls / results / segments: `0 / 0 / 0 / 0`
* failure: `insufficient_scene_samples` + missing mandatory coverage

## Scope

Implement a deterministic, auditable sampling evidence-sufficiency rescue before formal window publish:

1. Do not weaken <issue id="f65aaa95-5703-45df-9d12-1dbf2f96d813" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-15/perception-publish-gatemulti-frame-evidence-skipped-不得假性成功">VID-15</issue> publish gate, 12s maximum span, hard scene boundary, large-gap policy, or Doctor capability contract.
2. After normal adaptive sampling + visual dedupe, detect a clip/protected region that has 0 legal mandatory 3-frame window while discarded real candidate frames could form one.
3. Recover the minimum necessary discarded candidate frames to create at least one legal 3-frame window within existing span/boundary rules. This is local rescue, not a global dedupe-threshold relaxation.
4. Recovered frames must be real extracted/candidate frames, deterministic, unique by fingerprint/timestamp, and auditable with reason such as `evidence_sufficiency_rescue` plus original dedupe decision/provenance.
5. Preserve normal cap/cost controls; do not inflate all clips or create unnecessary model calls.
6. If no legal 3-frame set exists even from available candidates, remain fail-closed with explicit `insufficient_scene_samples`; never invent/duplicate frames or cross protected boundaries.
7. Stable IDs / human override / source immutability remain unchanged.

## Regressions

* current sparse pattern can recover a legal triple when discarded candidates make one possible.
* no rescue when normal retained frames already produce mandatory windows.
* no crossing hard scene boundary / large temporal gap / >12s span.
* no duplicate fingerprint/timestamp and no synthetic frame reuse.
* deterministic repeat run chooses same rescue frames and window UUIDs.
* rescue amount is minimal and bounded.
* truly impossible clip remains 0 calls and fail-closed.
* <issue id="f65aaa95-5703-45df-9d12-1dbf2f96d813" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-15/perception-publish-gatemulti-frame-evidence-skipped-不得假性成功">VID-15</issue> exact mandatory manifest/result/segment coverage remains strict.

## Real acceptance

Use isolated real Coffee on latest main + this branch:

Doctor --full → import → formal Perception for both Coffee clips.

Required:

* Doctor 0 blocked; capability source verified/auditable.
* clip_001 remains PASS without regression.
* clip_002 produces at least one legal mandatory window only if real discarded candidate evidence makes that possible.
* actual E4B model calls > 0 for clip_002, complete mandatory UUID result coverage, publish contract PASS before segments.
* no threshold relaxation, mock provider, cloud fallback, manual DB patch, or source mutation.
* source SHA/size/mtime and production data unchanged.

If both clips PASS, continue <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> from Story generation onward. If a new authoritative gate fails, stop at the first blocker and attach evidence; do not mark <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> / <issue id="0b064e3d-4d7f-4e8e-b57c-3c7b621c7716" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-11/真實流程驗收-round-1阻塞修正與產品硬化">VID-11</issue> Done.
